author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(a.h1,{id:"using-ar-work-instructions-to-standardise-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:["Using AR work instructions to standardise rare or high risk procedures",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#using-ar-work-instructions-to-standardise-rare-or-high-risk-procedures",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial teams regularly face procedures that, while rare, carry significant risk. Complex changeovers, emergency shutdowns, confined space entries, and critical maintenance tasks demand absolute precision. Yet, because these procedures are performed infrequently, even experienced technicians and operators can struggle to recall exact steps, increasing the risk of errors, incidents, and downtime."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) work instructions offer a practical, proven way to standardise these rare or high risk procedures—making work safer, more consistent, and easier to audit."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-rare-and-high-risk-procedures-remain-a-challenge",children:["Why rare and high risk procedures remain a challenge",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-rare-and-high-risk-procedures-remain-a-challenge",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Most industrial sites have robust standard operating procedures (SOPs) for daily tasks. But rare or high risk procedures create unique challenges:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Technicians may not have repeated exposure to the steps, so memory fades."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Paper-based SOPs can be overlooked, misinterpreted, or outdated."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Verbal handovers lose detail, especially across shifts or teams."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"High risk tasks often require rapid, correct action under pressure."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Auditors and safety leads need clear evidence of compliance and training."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For example, a chemical plant may only perform a full vessel decontamination once a year. A water utility might only isolate major pipelines during emergency repairs. In these cases, a single mistake can lead to injuries, environmental incidents, or costly downtime."}),"
",r(a.p,{children:["Research from the Institution of Chemical Engineers (IChemE) highlights that rare procedures are disproportionately represented in incident reports, largely due to lapses in memory, unclear instructions, or incomplete handovers (",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.icheme.org/",children:"IChemE, 2020"}),")."]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"why-now-regulatory-and-workforce-trends-increase-the-need-for-standardisation",children:["Why now: regulatory and workforce trends increase the need for standardisation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-regulatory-and-workforce-trends-increase-the-need-for-standardisation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Several trends are converging to make standardisation of rare and high risk procedures a top priority:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Stricter regulatory requirements"})," for evidence-based training and procedural compliance."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Aging workforce"})," and increased turnover, leading to loss of institutional knowledge."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"More complex equipment"})," and interconnected systems, raising the stakes for error."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Digital transformation"})," mandates, requiring traceable, auditable processes."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For operations managers, HSE leads, and training professionals, relying on static documents or informal coaching is no longer enough. Digital solutions that deliver guidance at the point of work—and capture proof of execution—are now essential for operational excellence."}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-work-instructions-support-safer-more-consistent-execution",children:["How AR work instructions support safer, more consistent execution",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-work-instructions-support-safer-more-consistent-execution",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions combine visual, step-by-step guidance with real-time data and context. Delivered via smart glasses, tablets, or mobile devices, they overlay digital instructions onto the physical workspace, making each step clear and unambiguous."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Key features include:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Visual overlays:"})," Diagrams, animations, and markers that show exactly where to act."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Interactive checklists:"})," Require confirmation or input before proceeding."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Embedded reference materials:"})," Safety data sheets, equipment manuals, or video clips."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Contextual prompts:"})," Adapt instructions based on sensor data or operator input."]}),"
",r(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Automated documentation:"})," Capture time-stamped records, photos, and digital sign-offs."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This approach addresses the core risks of rare or high risk procedures:"}),"
",r(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Reduces reliance on memory or paper."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Ensures critical steps are not skipped or performed out of sequence."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Supports less experienced team members with just-in-time knowledge."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Provides real-time support for troubleshooting or escalation."}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.blockquote,{children:["
",r(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," A 2022 study by the Fraunhofer Institute found that AR-guided procedures reduced error rates by 40% and improved procedural compliance by over 30% in pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturing."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(a.h2,{id:"use-cases-where-ar-sops-make-the-biggest-impact",children:["Use cases: where AR SOPs make the biggest impact",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-where-ar-sops-make-the-biggest-impact",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR work instructions are particularly valuable for procedures where the stakes are high and repetition is low. Common industrial use cases include:"}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"emergency-shutdowns-and-lockouttagout-loto",children:["Emergency shutdowns and lockout/tagout (LOTO)",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#emergency-shutdowns-and-lockouttagout-loto",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"When a line or facility must be safely powered down, every step matters. AR SOPs guide technicians through the correct sequence, confirm each isolation point, and record proof of execution—minimising the risk of accidental energisation."}),"
",r(a.h3,{id:"confined-space-entries",children:["Confined space entries",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#confined-space-entries",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) is moving from niche pilot to critical tool in industrial operations. For operations, maintenance, and HSE leaders, AR projects promise measurable gains: faster onboarding, safer procedures, and fewer errors. But these benefits only materialize if your teams—operators, supervisors, and IT—adopt the new way of working. That's why effective change management for AR projects is essential."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-change-management-matters-in-ar-projects",children:["Why change management matters in AR projects",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-change-management-matters-in-ar-projects",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Introducing digital work instructions or AI and AR–guided work instructions isn't just a technology upgrade. It's a shift in how work gets done, how knowledge is shared, and how compliance is proven. Too often, AR pilots stall because the change management piece is missing: teams go through the motions, but don't fully engage."}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Common challenges include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Operators reverting to old habits or paper SOPs"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Supervisors unclear on how to coach or measure new workflows"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"IT teams wary about device management and support"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Resistance due to perceived complexity or lack of value"}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"A structured approach to change management helps overcome these barriers by aligning stakeholders, clarifying benefits, and supporting adoption from day one."}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"Every AR implementation involves multiple stakeholder groups, each with unique concerns and needs."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"operators",children:["Operators",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#operators",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Operators are the frontline users of AR-guided work instructions. Their buy-in is critical, yet they often have the most to lose if the transition is poorly managed. Common concerns include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Fear of being monitored or evaluated more closely"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Uncertainty about new technology and devices"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:'Loss of autonomy or "the way we've always done it"'}),"
"]}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"Supervisors play a central role in reinforcing new behaviors and coaching their teams. For AR projects, they need to understand:"}),"

"]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"it-and-digital-teams",children:["IT and digital teams",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#it-and-digital-teams",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"IT is responsible for device management, security, integration, and support. Their concerns often center on:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Scalability of device management (especially for smart glasses or tablets)"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Data security and compliance"}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Integration with existing systems like MES, ERP, or CMMS"}),"
"]}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"Training professionals need to update curricula, while HR may need to address role changes or new competency requirements. Both should be involved early in the process."}),"

",i(r.p,{children:["Before launching any change initiative, make sure everyone understands ",n(r.em,{children:"why"}),". Communicate the specific business problems AR will address—whether it's onboarding time, quality issues, or safety incidents. Use data from pilots or benchmarks to quantify the opportunity."]}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"involve-stakeholders-early",children:["Involve stakeholders early",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#involve-stakeholders-early",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Don't wait until the rollout to engage operators or IT. Include them in pilots, solicit feedback, and adjust based on real-world input. Early involvement builds ownership and surfaces potential issues before they become blockers."}),"
",i(r.h3,{id:"define-success-metrics-upfront",children:["Define success metrics upfront",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#define-success-metrics-upfront",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Set clear KPIs for the AR project and communicate them to all stakeholders. Metrics might include:"}),"

",n(r.li,{children:"User engagement with AR instructions"}),"
"]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Transparent metrics help focus the effort and demonstrate value as the project progresses."}),"

",n(r.p,{children:"Change management is not a one-time event. Keep stakeholders informed of progress, challenges, and adjustments. Use regular updates, town halls, or digital channels to maintain visibility and engagement."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"overcoming-common-resistance",children:["Overcoming common resistance",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#overcoming-common-resistance",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const r={a:"a",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"cybersecurity-and-data-privacy-when-deploying-ar-and-ai-in-operations",children:["Cybersecurity and data privacy when deploying AR and AI in operations",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#cybersecurity-and-data-privacy-when-deploying-ar-and-ai-in-operations",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming industrial operations. Companies use AR and AI–guided work instructions to digitize inspections, standardize procedures, and accelerate training. But as these tools connect devices, data, and teams, new risks emerge around cybersecurity and data privacy. For operations, HSE, and IT leaders, ensuring that AR and AI deployments are secure is now a non-negotiable part of digital transformation."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"rising-adoption-of-ar-and-ai-in-industrial-environments",children:["Rising adoption of AR and AI in industrial environments",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#rising-adoption-of-ar-and-ai-in-industrial-environments",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Industrial organizations are under pressure to optimize productivity, maintain high safety standards, and transfer knowledge efficiently. AR and AI–guided work instructions address these needs:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",n(r.li,{children:"Field engineers use AR headsets to follow digital SOPs hands-free."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Maintenance leads leverage AI to flag anomalies during inspections."}),"
",n(r.li,{children:"Training managers accelerate onboarding with interactive, real-time guidance."}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.p,{children:["According to ",n(r.a,{href:"https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/issues/technology/ai-analysis.html",children:"PwC"}),", over 70% of industrial companies plan to increase their investment in AI by 2025. AR adoption is also accelerating as hardware becomes more practical and content creation tools mature."]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"But as these technologies move from pilots to production, the attack surface expands. Devices with cameras and microphones, cloud-connected analytics, and real-time data sharing all present new entry points for cyber threats and privacy breaches."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-cybersecurity-and-data-privacy-demand-urgent-attention",children:["Why cybersecurity and data privacy demand urgent attention",n(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-cybersecurity-and-data-privacy-demand-urgent-attention",children:n(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(r.p,{children:"Industrial operations handle sensitive information: production parameters, equipment status, safety incidents, and sometimes personal data about technicians. When AR and AI platforms are introduced, the following risks become more pressing:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Unauthorized access:"})," AR devices and connected platforms may be targeted for credential theft or unauthorized access attempts."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Data interception:"})," Real-time video, sensor data, and work logs transmitted over networks can be intercepted if not properly encrypted."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Privacy breaches:"})," Devices often collect audio, video, and location data that may be subject to GDPR or other privacy regulations."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Malware and ransomware:"})," AI algorithms and AR devices are potential vectors for malware if not secured and updated regularly."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[n(r.strong,{children:"Loss of operational integrity:"})," Compromised digital work instructions can lead to unsafe procedures or quality escapes."]}),"
"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Before hands-on work, many roles require background knowledge—understanding equipment, processes, or regulations. AR can:"}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Not all training scenarios are equally suited for AR. Consider the following principles when designing AR training content:"}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"Prioritize procedures where errors have significant consequences—safety-critical steps, complex assemblies, or tasks with high variation. AR's value is greatest where the cost of mistakes is highest."}),"

",e(r.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) and artificial intelligence (AI)–guided work instructions are changing how industrial teams work, train, and stay safe. This article provides a practical, step-by-step roadmap for moving from pilot to global rollout, ensuring measurable gains in productivity, quality, safety, and workforce readiness."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-scaling-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-matters-now",children:["Why scaling AR and AI–guided work instructions matters now",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-scaling-ar-and-aiguided-work-instructions-matters-now",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",code:"code",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",pre:"pre",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h1,{id:"how-to-set-up-an-internal-ar-content-factory-with-subject-matter-experts",children:["How to set up an internal AR content factory with subject matter experts",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-set-up-an-internal-ar-content-factory-with-subject-matter-experts",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Setting up an internal AR content factory with your subject matter experts is one of the most effective ways to deliver high-quality, up-to-date digital work instructions at scale. For operations, HSE, and L&D leaders, this approach enables safer, faster, and more consistent work while retaining critical know-how inside your organization."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"why-industrial-companies-need-an-ar-content-factory-now",children:["Why industrial companies need an AR content factory now",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-industrial-companies-need-an-ar-content-factory-now",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial organizations face pressure to maintain productivity, quality, and safety standards as senior staff retire and new technologies emerge. Many teams still rely on paper-based SOPs or scattered digital documents. These approaches often fail to capture expert knowledge or adapt quickly to change."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Key drivers making AR content creation urgent:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Aging workforce:"})," As experienced technicians retire, capturing their expertise is business-critical."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Complexity:"})," Equipment, regulations, and processes are more complex than ever."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Remote and distributed teams:"})," Consistent training and guidance are harder to deliver."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Safety and compliance:"})," Incomplete or outdated instructions increase risk and regulatory exposure."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Continuous improvement:"})," Feedback loops are slow when documentation is static."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Traditional training and documentation models are too slow and inflexible for today’s pace. AR and AI–guided work instructions offer a way to bring expert knowledge directly to the point of need, but only if you can create and update content efficiently."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"the-challenge-capturing-and-scaling-expert-knowledge",children:["The challenge: capturing and scaling expert knowledge",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-challenge-capturing-and-scaling-expert-knowledge",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Building a steady pipeline of digital work instructions using AR platforms requires two things:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Access to real subject matter experts (SMEs) who know your processes inside out."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"A repeatable, manageable way to capture, validate, and update their knowledge."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many companies struggle with:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Bottlenecks:"})," Only a few people can create AR content; IT or external vendors are overloaded."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Quality gaps:"})," SMEs are not trained in instructional design or AR tools."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Governance:"})," No clear process for reviewing, updating, and retiring work instructions."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Teams are unsure how to adopt new methods alongside existing SOPs."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"To address these challenges, leading organizations are setting up internal “AR content factories”—dedicated, cross-functional teams and processes to turn SME know-how into usable, scalable AR SOPs and digital work instructions."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"what-is-an-internal-ar-content-factory",children:["What is an internal AR content factory?",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-is-an-internal-ar-content-factory",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"An AR content factory is an internal capability that enables your organization to:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Rapidly capture task knowledge from SMEs."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Convert it into structured, AR–ready digital work instructions."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Validate, deploy, and update content as processes evolve."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ensure governance, quality, and compliance at every step."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The content factory model borrows from manufacturing: standardized workflows, clear roles, and a focus on repeatable quality. The difference is the “product” is actionable knowledge, not a physical part."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Key elements:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"SME engagement:"})," Operators, technicians, engineers, and process owners contribute knowledge."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content producers:"})," Team members trained to use AR authoring tools and instructional design principles."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Review and governance:"})," QA, HSE, and operations leaders review and approve content."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Feedback loops:"})," Continuous updates based on user feedback and process changes."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This approach scales AR SOPs and AI–guided instructions far beyond what a central documentation or training team could produce alone."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"how-an-ar-content-factory-works-in-practice",children:["How an AR content factory works in practice",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-an-ar-content-factory-works-in-practice",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Setting up an AR content factory is a change process. It involves new roles, workflows, and technology. Here is a practical breakdown of the major steps:"}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Start by identifying where AR and digital work instructions will have the highest impact. Common areas include:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Safety-critical maintenance tasks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Equipment changeovers and setups"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Quality inspections and audits"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Onboarding and upskilling for new team members"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Set clear goals, such as reducing errors, improving compliance, or accelerating onboarding."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"2-build-your-cross-functional-team",children:["2. Build your cross-functional team",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#2-build-your-cross-functional-team",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A successful AR content factory brings together:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Subject matter experts:"})," Field engineers, operators, maintenance leads, QA and HSE specialists."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content producers:"})," L&D or technical writers trained in AR authoring."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reviewers:"})," Supervisors, safety officers, and process owners for governance."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"IT and platform support:"})," To ensure tool access and integration."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Keep the team lean but representative. For most organizations, a core group of 5–10 is enough to start."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"3-select-the-right-ar-authoring-tools",children:["3. Select the right AR authoring tools",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#3-select-the-right-ar-authoring-tools",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Choose a platform that:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Allows non-technical users to capture and structure procedures visually (e.g., via guided video, step-by-step overlays, voice annotations)."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Supports AI-driven suggestions for content structure and translation."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Integrates with your learning or asset management systems."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Enables easy content updates and version control."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The right tool should empower SMEs to contribute directly, not just content specialists."}),"

",n(t.p,{children:"Develop a clear, repeatable workflow:"}),"

",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Review:"})," QA, HSE, or operations leads review for accuracy, safety, and compliance."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Publish:"})," Approved content is released to teams via AR devices or mobile apps."]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Feedback:"})," End users flag issues or suggest improvements, triggering updates."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Create templates for different task types to ensure consistency."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"5-train-your-smes-and-content-producers",children:["5. Train your SMEs and content producers",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#5-train-your-smes-and-content-producers",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Most SMEs are not instructional designers. Provide short, focused training on:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Using AR authoring tools"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Structuring clear, actionable instructions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Capturing safety and compliance requirements"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Reviewing and updating content"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Pair less experienced contributors with mentors to accelerate learning."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"6-establish-governance-and-quality-control",children:["6. Establish governance and quality control",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#6-establish-governance-and-quality-control",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Define who owns each type of content and how updates are managed. Key governance measures:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Version control for all AR SOPs and digital work instructions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Scheduled reviews (e.g., every 6–12 months)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Clear criteria for retiring or archiving outdated content"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Audit trails for compliance"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Assign responsibility for monitoring usage data and feedback."}),"
",r(t.h3,{id:"7-pilot-measure-and-scale",children:["7. Pilot, measure, and scale",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#7-pilot-measure-and-scale",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Start with a focused pilot in one department or process. Measure:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Time to create and deploy new AR SOPs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Reduction in errors, incidents, or rework"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"User adoption and satisfaction"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Impact on onboarding speed"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Use results to refine your process and build support for wider rollout."}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"use-cases-where-ar-content-factories-deliver-results",children:["Use cases: where AR content factories deliver results",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-where-ar-content-factories-deliver-results",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial organizations have seen measurable benefits from internal AR content factories in areas such as:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["

title: Mobile first or AR first: choosing the right starting point for your organisation
description: Industrial leaders: Should you prioritise mobile digital work instructions or AR-guided workflows? Compare approaches, benefits, and next steps for smarter operations.

image.alt: Mobile first or AR first: choosing the right starting point for your organisation

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:i,jsxs:n}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",code:"code",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",pre:"pre",span:"span",strong:"strong",table:"table",tbody:"tbody",td:"td",th:"th",thead:"thead",tr:"tr",ul:"ul",...r.components};return n(e,{children:[n(t.h1,{id:"mobile-first-or-ar-first-choosing-the-right-starting-point-for-your-organisation",children:["Mobile first or AR first: choosing the right starting point for your organisation",i(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#mobile-first-or-ar-first-choosing-the-right-starting-point-for-your-organisation",children:i(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"Industrial leaders face a critical decision: Should you digitise your standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions with a mobile-first approach, or invest directly in AI and AR–guided workflows? This choice impacts productivity, safety, training efficiency, and digital maturity. Understanding which starting point fits your organisation can set the pace for measurable improvements in operations."}),"
",n(t.h2,{id:"the-context-digital-work-instructions-in-industry",children:["The context: digital work instructions in industry",i(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-context-digital-work-instructions-in-industry",children:i(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"Industries from manufacturing to energy and chemicals are under pressure to improve safety, compliance, and workforce productivity. Ageing workforces, increasing complexity, and evolving regulatory demands create a need for robust knowledge capture and transfer. Traditional paper-based SOPs and legacy systems often fall short—leading to errors, delays, and inconsistent outcomes."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"Digital work instructions, delivered via mobile devices or augmented reality (AR) headsets, address these challenges by:"}),"
",n(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:"Standardising procedures and reducing human error"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Supporting real-time guidance and documentation"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Enabling faster onboarding and upskilling"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Providing traceable compliance records"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"But the path to digitalising SOPs is not one-size-fits-all. The decision to start with mobile or AR depends on your current state, priorities, and readiness for change."}),"
",n(t.h2,{id:"why-the-choice-between-mobile-first-and-ar-first-matters-now",children:["Why the choice between mobile first and AR first matters now",i(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-the-choice-between-mobile-first-and-ar-first-matters-now",children:i(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"Digital transformation is no longer optional for industrial operations. However, the speed and scope of change must balance risk, cost, and business continuity. The choice between mobile first and AR first is about more than technology—it is about setting your teams up for success and scaling digital adoption sustainably."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"Key trends driving this decision include:"}),"
",n(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:[i(t.strong,{children:"Workforce demographics:"})," Many industrial teams are managing knowledge transfer as experienced technicians retire or shift roles. Mobile and AR tools both support skills capture, but differ in usability and impact."]}),"
",n(t.li,{children:[i(t.strong,{children:"Regulatory requirements:"})," Increasing documentation and compliance demands push organisations to digitise SOPs and evidence execution."]}),"
",n(t.li,{children:[i(t.strong,{children:"Hardware maturity:"})," Mobile devices are ubiquitous and familiar, while AR headsets are rapidly advancing but may require more investment and training."]}),"
",n(t.li,{children:[i(t.strong,{children:"IT and change management:"})," Integrations, cybersecurity, and user adoption must be considered for both approaches."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"A clear, phased strategy helps avoid common pitfalls—such as stalled pilots, fragmented content, or low engagement."}),"
",n(t.h2,{id:"comparing-mobile-first-and-ar-first-approaches",children:["Comparing mobile first and AR first approaches",i(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#comparing-mobile-first-and-ar-first-approaches",children:i(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.h3,{id:"what-does-mobile-first-mean",children:["What does mobile first mean?",i(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-does-mobile-first-mean",children:i(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"A mobile-first approach digitises work instructions, checklists, and SOPs for use on smartphones and tablets. Teams access step-by-step guidance, capture photos or video as proof, and submit reports—all from familiar devices. Key features include:"}),"
",n(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:"Digital SOPs and checklists"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Barcode scanning and asset tracking"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Photo and video capture for documentation"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Integration with existing maintenance or quality systems"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Offline access for remote sites"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"Mobile-first solutions are often easier to deploy at scale, with minimal hardware investment and lower training barriers."}),"
",n(t.h3,{id:"what-does-ar-first-mean",children:["What does AR first mean?",i(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-does-ar-first-mean",children:i(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:"An AR-first approach delivers digital work instructions and AI-powered guidance through wearable devices like smart glasses or headsets. Information is overlaid directly onto the work environment, offering hands-free, context-aware support. Capabilities include:"}),"
",n(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:"Step-by-step AR overlays on equipment or assets"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Real-time remote expert assistance (see-what-I-see)"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Automatic recognition of components and tasks using computer vision"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Hands-free operation for safety-critical or complex tasks"}),"
",i(t.li,{children:"Enhanced data capture (e.g., voice notes, video, sensor data)"}),"
"]}),"

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"safety-first-using-ar-to-enforce-critical-checks-and-lockout-tagout-procedures",children:["Safety first: using AR to enforce critical checks and lockout tagout procedures",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#safety-first-using-ar-to-enforce-critical-checks-and-lockout-tagout-procedures",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Safety, compliance and uptime are at the core of every industrial operation. For operations managers, HSE leads, and maintenance supervisors, ensuring that critical checks—especially lockout tagout (LOTO) procedures—are followed to the letter is non-negotiable. Yet, even with established SOPs, human error, knowledge gaps, and inconsistent documentation can put teams and assets at risk. AI and AR–guided work instructions now offer a practical way to digitize and enforce these essential safety steps, directly on the shop floor."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-critical-safety-checks-and-lockout-tagout-still-fail",children:["Why critical safety checks and lockout tagout still fail",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-critical-safety-checks-and-lockout-tagout-still-fail",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Despite decades of safety programs and investments in training, critical safety checks and LOTO procedures are still a leading cause of incidents in manufacturing, utilities, and process industries. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, failure to control hazardous energy (including LOTO violations) consistently ranks among the most cited OSHA violations, leading to hundreds of preventable injuries each year (",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.osha.gov/lockout-tagout",children:"source"}),")."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Common reasons why critical checks and LOTO still break down:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Paper-based SOPs are hard to update and easy to ignore."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams may skip steps under production pressure or due to unclear instructions."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"New or contract technicians may lack hands-on experience with site-specific hazards."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Supervisors have limited real-time visibility into who performed which check, and how thoroughly."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These gaps are not just compliance issues—they are business risks. Incidents resulting from missed LOTO steps can lead to severe injury, equipment damage, production losses, and regulatory penalties."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-change-is-needed-now",children:["Why change is needed now",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-change-is-needed-now",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Industrial operations face increasing pressure to improve safety and reduce downtime, while also dealing with workforce turnover and tightening regulations. The traditional model—periodic classroom training, paper checklists, and spot audits—is struggling to keep up."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Key drivers for change:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Rising complexity:"})," Modern equipment and distributed assets require more nuanced, step-by-step safety checks."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Workforce dynamics:"})," High turnover and the use of contractors mean many people on site are unfamiliar with specific SOPs."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Regulatory scrutiny:"})," Digital records and traceability are now expected, not optional, in many jurisdictions."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Production demands:"})," Teams are often asked to do more with less, increasing the temptation to cut corners."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many organizations are looking for a way to make safety procedures truly actionable and auditable—without slowing down operations."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-help-enforce-safety-and-loto",children:["How AI and AR–guided work instructions help enforce safety and LOTO",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-help-enforce-safety-and-loto",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions bridge the gap between policy and practice. Instead of static documents or memory-based routines, these systems deliver step-by-step, interactive guidance directly to technicians at the point of work. For LOTO and other critical safety checks, this means:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Visual cues:"})," AR overlays show the exact location of valves, switches, or isolation points on real equipment."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Mandatory confirmations:"})," Steps can require photos, scans, or digital signatures before allowing the workflow to proceed."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Contextual intelligence:"})," AI adapts instructions to the specific asset, task, and environment—reducing ambiguity."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Real-time traceability:"})," Every action is time-stamped and logged, creating a digital audit trail for compliance."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"example-ar-sops-for-lockout-tagout",children:["Example: AR SOPs for lockout tagout",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#example-ar-sops-for-lockout-tagout",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A technician tasked with isolating a pump for maintenance uses a tablet or AR headset. The AR SOP guides them through:"}),"
",i(t.ol,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Identifying the correct isolation points (highlighted in their field of view)."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Scanning QR codes or NFC tags to confirm lockout devices are applied."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Photographing the locked-out state for supervisor review."}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Completing a digital checklist that cannot be submitted unless all steps are verified."}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Supervisors can monitor progress in real time and review a full digital record—eliminating guesswork and after-the-fact investigations."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"use-cases-where-ar-lockout-tagout-and-critical-checks-add-value",children:["Use cases: where AR lockout tagout and critical checks add value",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-where-ar-lockout-tagout-and-critical-checks-add-value",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions for safety and LOTO are being implemented in the following scenarios:"}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"planned-maintenance-shutdowns",children:["Planned maintenance shutdowns",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#planned-maintenance-shutdowns",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"During major turnarounds, dozens of technicians—often from multiple contractors—must isolate and de-energize equipment. AR SOPs ensure that every step is followed consistently, and that supervisors have a live dashboard of lockout status across the site."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"emergency-interventions",children:["Emergency interventions",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#emergency-interventions",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In urgent situations, it is easy to miss a step or bypass documentation. AR-guided workflows walk teams through the correct sequence, even under pressure, and capture proof for later review."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"training-and-onboarding",children:["Training and onboarding",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#training-and-onboarding",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"New team members or contractors can follow AR SOPs that combine site-specific visuals with interactive prompts, reducing reliance on tribal knowledge and shadowing."}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"routine-inspections-and-audits",children:["Routine inspections and audits",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#routine-inspections-and-audits",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Regular safety inspections are digitized and guided, with AI flagging missed steps or inconsistencies for corrective action."}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Note:"})," AR and AI–guided work instructions are not limited to LOTO. They can be applied to any critical safety check, including confined space entry, hot work permits, and pre-start inspections."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"results-measurable-improvements-in-safety-and-compliance",children:["Results: measurable improvements in safety and compliance",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-measurable-improvements-in-safety-and-compliance",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Organizations adopting AI and AR–guided work instructions for LOTO and safety checks report:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Fewer missed steps:"})," Digital workflows make it nearly impossible to skip or fake critical actions."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Faster incident investigations:"})," Complete, time-stamped records are available instantly."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Improved compliance:"})," Auditors can review digital evidence rather than relying on paper forms or memory."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reduced training time:"})," New technicians reach proficiency faster, with less risk."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Higher engagement:"})," Teams value clear, visual instructions over dense SOP binders."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A 2023 case study from a large European chemicals manufacturer found that digitizing LOTO procedures with AR reduced procedural violations by 60% and cut supervisor review time in half (internal audit, client data shared with permission)."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"addressing-objections-hardware-content-and-change-management",children:["Addressing objections: hardware, content, and change management",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-objections-hardware-content-and-change-management",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Adopting AR SOPs and digital work instructions requires practical planning. Common concerns include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Hardware requirements:"})," Most AR SOPs can run on standard tablets or smartphones; specialist headsets are optional for hands-free use."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Content creation:"})," Converting existing SOPs to digital, visual formats is a one-time effort, with ongoing updates managed centrally."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Change management:"})," Success depends on engaging teams early, demonstrating clear benefits, and aligning digital workflows with existing safety policies."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion works with clients to assess readiness, pilot AR SOPs in high-impact areas, and support training and rollout."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-safety-and-loto-enforcement",children:["What ActARion brings to safety and LOTO enforcement",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-safety-and-loto-enforcement",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"ActARion specializes in helping industrial organizations implement AI and AR–guided work instructions that drive measurable improvements in safety, quality, and productivity."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Key capabilities:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Rapid digitization:"})," We convert your existing LOTO procedures and critical checks into interactive, AR-enabled workflows."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Integration:"})," ActARion connects with your EHS, CMMS, or training systems for seamless data flow."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Governance:"})," Full audit trails, permissions, and change controls support compliance and continuous improvement."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Scalability:"})," Start with one process or line, and expand across your operations as needed."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Our approach is grounded in practical experience with global manufacturers, utilities, and energy companies. We focus on real-world results, not generic technology promises."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"explore-this-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore this in your organisation",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-this-in-your-organisation",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"See how AI and AR–guided work instructions could reduce risk and improve compliance in your safety-critical processes. Schedule a discovery call to explore a pilot for your LOTO procedures or critical safety checks—no commitment required."}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(t.a,{href:"/use-cases/digital-work-instructions",children:"digital work instructions for maintenance"})," or see how ",n(t.a,{href:"/use-cases/ar-onboarding",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"})," accelerates skills transfer. For a regulatory overview of LOTO requirements, visit ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.osha.gov/lockout-tagout",children:"OSHA’s lockout tagout page"}),"."]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"

title: Scaling AR from one plant to many: governance, templates and standards
description: How operations, HSE and L&D leaders can scale AR SOPs across multiple sites with robust governance, templates and standards.

image.alt: Scaling AR from one plant to many: governance, templates and standards

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:n,jsx:e,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const r={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(n,{children:[i(r.h1,{id:"scaling-ar-from-one-plant-to-many-governance-templates-and-standards",children:["Scaling AR from one plant to many: governance, templates and standards",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#scaling-ar-from-one-plant-to-many-governance-templates-and-standards",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) work instructions are delivering measurable safety and productivity gains in industrial plants worldwide. For operations managers, HSE leads, and L&D teams, the next challenge is clear: how do you scale successful AR SOPs from a single pilot site to multiple plants—without losing control, consistency or quality?"}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"This article explores the governance, templates, and standards required to scale AR across your organisation. It addresses common pitfalls, provides concrete examples, and outlines actionable steps for decision makers who need to justify investment and prove ROI at scale."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"the-challenge-why-scaling-ar-beyond-one-site-is-hard",children:["The challenge: why scaling AR beyond one site is hard",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-challenge-why-scaling-ar-beyond-one-site-is-hard",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Many industrial companies have launched AR pilots or small-scale deployments. Results are promising: reduced onboarding time, fewer errors, and better compliance documentation. The real test comes when expanding AR digital work instructions beyond the pilot plant."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Common challenges include:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Inconsistent SOPs and content quality between sites"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Local workarounds that undermine safety or auditability"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Duplicate efforts, wasted resources, and version sprawl"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Difficulty maintaining content as equipment or regulations change"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Lack of clear ownership for updating, reviewing and approving instructions"}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Without a governance framework, AR initiatives can stall or even backfire. Operators may revert to legacy methods, and management loses confidence in the value of digital work instructions."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"why-now-trends-driving-the-need-for-robust-ar-governance",children:["Why now: trends driving the need for robust AR governance",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-now-trends-driving-the-need-for-robust-ar-governance",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Several trends make it urgent for industrial leaders to establish strong AR SOP governance:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Workforce turnover and skills gap:"})," As experienced technicians retire, consistent, high-quality digital work instructions are critical for onboarding and knowledge retention (McKinsey, 2023)."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Increasing regulatory pressure:"})," Auditable, up-to-date SOPs are no longer optional in many industries. Digital AR SOPs provide a clear record of compliance."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Globalisation and distributed operations:"})," Multi-site manufacturers need standardisation to ensure quality and safety, regardless of location."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Rapid technology adoption:"})," AR hardware and platforms are maturing, but content chaos can undermine the business case without structure."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.blockquote,{children:["
",i(r.p,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Note:"})," According to a 2022 Capgemini survey, 74% of industrial companies deploying AR cite “scalability and standardisation” as their top concern (",e(r.a,{href:"https://www.capgemini.com/research/the-business-value-of-ar/",children:"Capgemini Research Institute, 2022"}),")."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"governance-the-foundation-for-scaling-ar-work-instructions",children:["Governance: the foundation for scaling AR work instructions",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#governance-the-foundation-for-scaling-ar-work-instructions",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Effective AR SOP scaling starts with governance. This means more than IT policy or content approval—it’s about defining roles, responsibilities, and processes across plants."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Key elements of robust AR governance:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Central AR steering committee:"})," A cross-functional team (operations, HSE, IT, training) to set standards, review metrics, and manage change."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Site champions:"})," Local experts responsible for adapting and implementing AR SOPs, providing feedback, and ensuring adoption."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Content ownership and lifecycle management:"})," Clear assignment of who creates, reviews, approves, and updates each SOP."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Audit and compliance process:"})," Regular checks to ensure AR instructions meet regulatory, safety, and quality standards."]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Feedback and continuous improvement:"})," Structured channels for technicians and supervisors to suggest updates and report issues."]}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"A centralised governance model ensures consistency, while local involvement drives relevance and adoption."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"templates-driving-consistency-and-efficiency-in-ar-sops",children:["Templates: driving consistency and efficiency in AR SOPs",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#templates-driving-consistency-and-efficiency-in-ar-sops",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Templates are the backbone of scalable, high-quality AR work instructions. They provide structure, enforce best practices, and reduce duplication across sites."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Effective AR SOP templates should:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Standardise step types (e.g. safety checks, visual inspections, data entry)"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Include mandatory fields for equipment, PPE, regulatory references, and sign-off"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Support multimedia (photos, video, 3D models) for clarity and engagement"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Allow for local customisation where justified (e.g. site-specific hazards)"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Integrate with existing document control and EHS systems"}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Templates make it faster to create new digital instructions, simplify training for content authors, and ensure all teams follow the same process."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:e(r.strong,{children:"Example template elements:"})}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",e(r.li,{children:"Task objective and scope"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Required tools and PPE"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Step-by-step actions with AR overlays"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Safety and quality checks"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Data capture points (e.g. measurements, photos)"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Escalation or exception handling"}),"
",e(r.li,{children:"Revision history and approval status"}),"
"]}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"standards-ensuring-quality-safety-and-compliance-at-scale",children:["Standards: ensuring quality, safety and compliance at scale",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#standards-ensuring-quality-safety-and-compliance-at-scale",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Standards bring discipline to AR SOP deployment. They define what “good” looks like for content, usability, and compliance—across all plants."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Key standards for scaling AR SOPs:"}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Content quality:"})," Readability, accuracy, and visual clarity criteria"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Safety integration:"})," Mandatory inclusion of risk controls and lockout/tagout steps"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Version control:"})," Unique IDs, revision tracking, and sunset dates for outdated instructions"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Training and certification:"})," Requirements for SOP authors and reviewers"]}),"
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Hardware compatibility:"})," Minimum device specs and approved AR hardware lists"]}),"
"]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"By codifying standards, organisations reduce the risk of “shadow SOPs” and ensure every technician, in every location, receives the same level of guidance."}),"
",i(r.h2,{id:"how-ar-sops-work-at-scale-scenarios-and-use-cases",children:["How AR SOPs work at scale: scenarios and use cases",e(r.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-sops-work-at-scale-scenarios-and-use-cases",children:e(r.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",e(r.p,{children:"Scaling AR SOPs goes beyond digitising a few maintenance routines. It enables a step change in operational consistency and performance."}),"
",e(r.p,{children:e(r.strong,{children:"Common use cases for multi-site AR SOPs:"})}),"
",i(r.ul,{children:["
",i(r.li,{children:[e(r.strong,{children:"Planned maintenance:"})," Standardising critical asset checks across plants, ensuring every team follows the same best practice."]}),"

title: Typical pitfalls when starting with AR on the shop floor and how to avoid them
description: Understand the common pitfalls when implementing AR on the shop floor and learn practical strategies to ensure a successful rollout in industrial operations.

author: ActARion
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(a){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...a.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.h1,{id:"typical-pitfalls-when-starting-with-ar-on-the-shop-floor-and-how-to-avoid-them",children:["Typical pitfalls when starting with AR on the shop floor and how to avoid them",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#typical-pitfalls-when-starting-with-ar-on-the-shop-floor-and-how-to-avoid-them",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Augmented reality (AR) is changing how industrial teams work. But many companies face avoidable pitfalls when starting with AR on the shop floor. Understanding these challenges—and knowing how to avoid them—can mean the difference between a stalled pilot and a measurable improvement in safety, productivity and skills transfer."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"ar-on-the-shop-floor-context-and-urgency",children:["AR on the shop floor: context and urgency",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#ar-on-the-shop-floor-context-and-urgency",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Industrial operations face mounting pressure to improve safety, maintain compliance, and keep uptime high. At the same time, technical teams are aging and new hires often lack hands-on experience. According to ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/operations/our-insights/operations-blog/augmented-reality-in-manufacturing",children:"McKinsey"}),", AR is being adopted across manufacturing and maintenance to address these gaps by delivering real-time, digital work instructions directly in the field."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"However, moving from a promising AR pilot to broad shop floor deployment is rarely straightforward. Early missteps can stall progress, frustrate teams, and undermine confidence in digital solutions. For operations managers, HSE leads, and training professionals, it’s critical to anticipate these pitfalls and address them head-on."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"why-ar-initiatives-often-struggle-on-the-shop-floor",children:["Why AR initiatives often struggle on the shop floor",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-ar-initiatives-often-struggle-on-the-shop-floor",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many AR projects do not deliver the expected value. The root causes are practical, not technical. The most common pitfalls include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Choosing AR hardware without operator input"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Underestimating the effort to digitise SOPs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ignoring change management and training needs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lacking clear metrics for success and ROI"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Failing to integrate AR with existing systems and workflows"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Treating AR as a one-off pilot rather than a scalable program"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These issues are not unique to any one sector. Whether in process industries, discrete manufacturing, or field service, the same patterns emerge. Addressing them early is essential for a successful rollout."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-1-choosing-ar-hardware-without-operator-input",children:["Pitfall 1: choosing AR hardware without operator input",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-1-choosing-ar-hardware-without-operator-input",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Selecting the right AR device is not just an IT decision. It’s about how technicians and operators actually work. Common mistakes include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Selecting devices that are too heavy or uncomfortable for all-day use"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Overlooking compatibility with safety gear (e.g., helmets, gloves, eye protection)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ignoring the environmental conditions (dust, moisture, lighting, noise)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Choosing devices with short battery life or unreliable connectivity"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Note:"})," In a 2023 ",n(t.a,{href:"https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/issues/technology/augmented-reality.html",children:"PWC study"}),", 46% of industrial AR pilots failed due to poor hardware fit for the intended work environment."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Involve technicians and safety leads in hardware evaluation and field trials"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Test devices in real production scenarios, not just in the lab"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Prioritise hands-free, voice-controlled options where possible"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Document feedback and iterate before scaling up"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-2-underestimating-the-effort-to-digitise-sops",children:["Pitfall 2: underestimating the effort to digitise SOPs",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-2-underestimating-the-effort-to-digitise-sops",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A common misconception is that existing SOPs can be dropped straight into AR platforms. In reality, most SOPs are written for paper or PDF and need to be rethought for digital, step-by-step guidance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Typical issues include:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"SOPs that are too generic or lack actionable detail"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Steps that assume prior knowledge or omit key safety checks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Instructions that do not translate well to visual formats (images, 3D models, videos)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lack of standardisation across similar tasks"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-1",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-1",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Conduct a content audit to identify which SOPs are ready for digitisation"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Work with experienced trainers and operators to break down procedures into granular, auditable steps"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Use AR platforms that make content creation and updates easy for non-IT staff"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Pilot digital work instructions on a high-impact, frequently repeated task before scaling"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-3-ignoring-change-management-and-skills-transfer",children:["Pitfall 3: ignoring change management and skills transfer",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-3-ignoring-change-management-and-skills-transfer",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR is not just another tool—it changes how work gets done. Teams who feel left out of the process may resist adoption or revert to old habits."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Common signs of inadequate change management:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Operators revert to paper instructions after initial enthusiasm fades"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Supervisors are not trained to coach or monitor digital work"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Training is a one-off event, not a continuous process"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams see AR as an “extra task” rather than a productivity aid"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-2",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-2",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Involve operators, supervisors, and HSE early in the design and rollout"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Provide hands-on, scenario-based AR training (not just classroom sessions)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Appoint AR champions in each team to support peers and gather feedback"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Build AR use into daily routines, audits, and shift handovers"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-4-lacking-clear-metrics-for-success-and-roi",children:["Pitfall 4: lacking clear metrics for success and ROI",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-4-lacking-clear-metrics-for-success-and-roi",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Without clear measures, it’s impossible to know if AR is delivering value. Many pilots fail because the goals are vague (“improve efficiency”) or not tracked at all."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Typical oversights:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"No baseline data on task time, error rates, or safety incidents"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Success measured only by user satisfaction, not operational KPIs"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"ROI assumptions based on vendor promises, not real data"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-3",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-3",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Define concrete metrics at the pilot stage (e.g., time to complete task, number of errors, incident reports)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Use AR platforms with built-in analytics to track usage and outcomes"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Compare before-and-after results on pilot tasks"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Report results to stakeholders and use them to refine the rollout"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-5-failing-to-integrate-ar-with-existing-systems-and-workflows",children:["Pitfall 5: failing to integrate AR with existing systems and workflows",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-5-failing-to-integrate-ar-with-existing-systems-and-workflows",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR is most effective when it fits seamlessly into existing workflows. A standalone AR app that requires duplicate data entry or manual syncing creates friction and risk."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Common integration issues:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"AR instructions are not linked to asset management or maintenance systems"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Work performed in AR is not logged in the main ERP or CMMS"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Operators must switch between devices or apps to complete a task"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-4",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-4",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Map out the end-to-end workflow before deploying AR"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Choose AR platforms with open APIs and proven integrations (e.g., SAP, Maximo, Infor EAM)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Prioritise use cases where digital work instructions close a real gap (e.g., onboarding, compliance checks, maintenance rounds)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Involve IT and process owners early to address integration and data governance"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"pitfall-6-treating-ar-as-a-one-off-pilot",children:["Pitfall 6: treating AR as a one-off pilot",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#pitfall-6-treating-ar-as-a-one-off-pilot",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Many organisations run a single AR pilot, then stall. This “pilot purgatory” happens when:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"There’s no plan for scaling successful pilots to other teams or sites"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Knowledge remains with a single project lead or vendor"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Lessons learned are not documented or shared"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h3,{id:"how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-5",children:["How to avoid this pitfall",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-to-avoid-this-pitfall-5",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Develop a roadmap for scaling AR across sites and processes"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Build internal capability for AR content creation and support"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Share results, templates, and lessons learned across teams"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Treat AR as part of your digital transformation, not a standalone project"}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-address-these-pitfalls",children:["How AI and AR–guided work instructions address these pitfalls",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-and-arguided-work-instructions-address-these-pitfalls",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI and AR–guided work instructions bring structure and traceability to shop floor processes. By digitising SOPs and delivering them through AR devices, teams receive:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Step-by-step digital instructions tailored to each task"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Visual cues (images, 3D models, videos) at the right moment"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Real-time data capture (e.g., photos, voice notes, checklists)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Automated compliance checks and safety prompts"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Analytics on task completion, errors, and time spent"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI can further personalise instructions based on operator experience, flag anomalies, and suggest improvements."}),"
",i(t.blockquote,{children:["
",i(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Example:"})," A global manufacturer reduced onboarding time for new maintenance technicians by 30% using AR SOPs, while also cutting error rates in critical tasks by 40%. (Internal case data, ActARion)"]}),"

",i(t.h2,{id:"practical-use-cases-for-ar-sops-on-the-shop-floor",children:["Practical use cases for AR SOPs on the shop floor",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#practical-use-cases-for-ar-sops-on-the-shop-floor",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Companies are seeing measurable results from AI and AR–guided work instructions in:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Equipment setup and changeovers (reducing downtime)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Maintenance and inspection rounds (improving traceability)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Quality checks and documentation (supporting compliance)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Safety-critical procedures (ensuring all steps are followed)"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Onboarding and upskilling new technicians (speeding time-to-competence)"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For each use case, the key is to start with a high-impact, repeatable process and expand based on feedback and results."}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-industrial-ar-deployments",children:["What ActARion brings to industrial AR deployments",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-industrial-ar-deployments",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
