",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial companies face constant pressure to maintain productivity, safety and quality while managing complex operations across multiple locations. Using AR for knowledge sharing across shifts, sites and countries helps teams capture and transfer expertise directly on the job, reducing errors and downtime."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-challenge-of-knowledge-sharing-in-industrial-environments",children:["The challenge of knowledge sharing in industrial environments",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-challenge-of-knowledge-sharing-in-industrial-environments",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial operations rarely stop. Teams work around the clock, often across different shifts and locations. Equipment, procedures and regulations vary between sites and countries, while experienced technicians retire or move roles. This leaves many companies struggling to:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Standardize procedures and best practices across locations"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Onboard new hires and temporary staff efficiently"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Prevent recurring errors caused by inconsistent knowledge transfer"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Ensure compliance with ever-changing safety and quality standards"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Traditional methods—paper manuals, static digital documents, classroom training—cannot keep up with the pace and complexity of modern industrial work. According to a 2023 report from the World Economic Forum, skills gaps and poor knowledge transfer are among the top five risks for manufacturing and process industries globally."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"why-knowledge-sharing-needs-to-change-now",children:["Why knowledge sharing needs to change now",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-knowledge-sharing-needs-to-change-now",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Several industry trends make effective knowledge sharing a critical priority:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Aging workforce:"})," Many experienced technicians are nearing retirement, taking decades of tacit knowledge with them."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Globalization:"})," Operations span multiple countries, languages and regulatory environments."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Increased complexity:"})," Equipment, processes and compliance requirements continue to evolve."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"High turnover:"})," Temporary and contract workers fill gaps but often lack site-specific expertise."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Remote and hybrid work:"})," Travel restrictions and distributed teams require new ways to collaborate and support each other."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"The cost of not addressing these challenges is significant. Studies by the Aberdeen Group indicate that poor knowledge transfer can lead to up to 20% higher operational costs, increased safety incidents, and longer downtimes during shift changes or after staff turnover."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions-support-knowledge-sharing",children:["How AR and AI-guided work instructions support knowledge sharing",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-and-ai-guided-work-instructions-support-knowledge-sharing",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"AR (augmented reality) combined with AI-guided work instructions offers a practical solution for capturing, standardizing and sharing expertise across shifts, sites and national borders. Here’s how it works:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Visual SOPs:"})," AR overlays digital work instructions, step-by-step guides and checklists directly onto equipment or workspaces, reducing ambiguity."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Context-aware support:"})," AI adapts instructions based on equipment version, operator experience, or local regulations."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Remote collaboration:"})," Experts can support teams in real time, regardless of location, using AR-enabled devices."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Automatic documentation:"})," As teams complete tasks, systems can log actions for compliance and continuous improvement."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Multilingual support:"})," Instructions can be delivered in multiple languages, tailored to the workforce at each site."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This approach moves beyond static documents and one-off training sessions, embedding knowledge directly into daily workflows."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"key-use-cases-for-ar-knowledge-sharing-across-shifts-and-sites",children:["Key use cases for AR knowledge sharing across shifts and sites",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#key-use-cases-for-ar-knowledge-sharing-across-shifts-and-sites",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"standardizing-maintenance-procedures",children:["Standardizing maintenance procedures",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#standardizing-maintenance-procedures",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A global chemical manufacturer operates plants in Europe and Asia. By using AR SOPs, they ensure every maintenance technician, regardless of location or shift, follows the same validated procedures for critical pump inspections. Visual overlays highlight exact components, torque values and safety checks, reducing errors and improving audit readiness. When a pump model is updated, instructions are updated centrally and rolled out instantly across all sites."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"supporting-shift-handovers",children:["Supporting shift handovers",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#supporting-shift-handovers",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"In a food processing facility, shift handovers were a common source of miscommunication and errors. With AR-guided work instructions, outgoing teams record notes and annotate equipment in real time. Incoming teams see these notes overlaid in context, alongside live data from IoT sensors. This reduces misunderstandings and helps teams prioritize urgent issues."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"cross-site-troubleshooting-and-remote-support",children:["Cross-site troubleshooting and remote support",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#cross-site-troubleshooting-and-remote-support",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A wind energy company with turbines in multiple countries uses AR to connect field engineers with remote experts. When a technician encounters an unfamiliar fault, they can share a live AR feed. The expert draws directly onto the technician’s view, guiding them step by step. This reduces travel costs, speeds up repairs and builds local competence."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"accelerating-onboarding-and-upskilling",children:["Accelerating onboarding and upskilling",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#accelerating-onboarding-and-upskilling",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A pharmaceutical plant faces frequent turnover among contract staff. Using AI and AR–guided work instructions, new operators access interactive, validated SOPs in their own language. Performance is tracked and knowledge gaps are flagged automatically, enabling targeted coaching. Time-to-competence drops by 30%, and compliance incidents decrease."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"results-measurable-impact-on-safety-quality-and-productivity",children:["Results: measurable impact on safety, quality and productivity",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#results-measurable-impact-on-safety-quality-and-productivity",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Companies adopting AR for knowledge sharing report clear benefits:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Fewer errors and incidents:"})," Visual, step-by-step guidance reduces reliance on memory and prevents shortcuts."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Faster onboarding:"})," New staff learn on the job, in context, without waiting for classroom sessions."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Consistent quality:"})," Standardized instructions ensure every technician executes tasks the same way, every time."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Higher productivity:"})," Less time spent searching for information or clarifying procedures."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Improved compliance:"})," Automatic logging and version control make audits simpler and more reliable."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For example, a 2022 pilot with an automotive supplier found that AR SOPs reduced assembly errors by 38% and cut average task duration by 25%, compared to traditional paper-based instructions."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"addressing-objections-practical-considerations",children:["Addressing objections: practical considerations",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#addressing-objections-practical-considerations",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Adopting AR and AI-guided work instructions brings up important questions for operations and HSE leaders:"}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"what-hardware-is-required",children:["What hardware is required?",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-hardware-is-required",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Most AR solutions run on commercially available smart glasses, tablets or smartphones. Device selection depends on the environment—smart glasses for hands-free use, rugged tablets for harsh conditions. Many companies start with a small pilot using existing devices before scaling up."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"how-is-content-created-and-maintained",children:["How is content created and maintained?",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-is-content-created-and-maintained",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Initial setup involves digitizing current SOPs and capturing expert workflows. Modern AR platforms allow subject matter experts to update instructions without coding. Governance is essential—assign responsibility for content validation, version control and local adaptation."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"how-do-you-manage-change-and-adoption",children:["How do you manage change and adoption?",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-do-you-manage-change-and-adoption",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Clear communication, involvement of end users, and strong leadership support are key. Start with high-impact use cases, gather feedback, and show quick wins. Training should focus on both the technology and new ways of working."}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"what-about-data-security-and-privacy",children:["What about data security and privacy?",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-about-data-security-and-privacy",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Industrial AR platforms comply with data protection regulations and offer granular access controls. Ensure your provider meets your company’s IT and compliance requirements."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"what-actarion-brings-to-industrial-knowledge-sharing",children:["What ActARion brings to industrial knowledge sharing",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-actarion-brings-to-industrial-knowledge-sharing",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion enables industrial companies to deploy AI and AR–guided work instructions tailored to their operational realities. Our approach is grounded in decades of experience supporting safety, productivity and workforce development in manufacturing, energy, chemicals and other sectors."}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"With ActARion, you can:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Digitize and standardize SOPs across sites and languages"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Enable real-time, context-aware guidance for every team and shift"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Connect experts with teams on the ground for remote troubleshooting"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Track compliance and performance for continuous improvement"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["We support your teams through every stage—from pilot to rollout—ensuring strong governance, data integrity and measurable ROI. See how ",n(a.a,{href:"/use-cases/ar-maintenance",children:"digital work instructions for maintenance"})," or ",n(a.a,{href:"/use-cases/ar-onboarding",children:"AR onboarding for technicians"})," deliver results in real-world settings."]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," For a deeper dive into AR and knowledge transfer in industry, see the ",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.weforum.org/reports/the-future-of-jobs-report-2023/",children:"World Economic Forum’s Future of Jobs Report 2023"}),"."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"explore-ar-knowledge-sharing-in-your-organisation",children:["Explore AR knowledge sharing in your organisation",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#explore-ar-knowledge-sharing-in-your-organisation",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"If you want to see how using AR for knowledge sharing across shifts, sites and countries could improve safety, productivity, and workforce readiness in your operations, schedule an exploratory call with ActARion. There’s no commitment—just an opportunity to map out potential use cases and ROI for your environment."}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["Learn more about ",n(a.a,{href:"/about",children:"how ActARion works"}),", or browse ",n(a.a,{href:"/faq",children:"answers to common AR implementation questions"}),". To discuss your specific process, ",n(a.a,{href:"/contact",children:"schedule a discovery call"}),"."]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Discover how AI and AR–guided work instructions can help your teams work smarter—wherever they are."})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:i}=e.components||{};return i?n(i,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"what-does-a-successful-ar-pilot-look-like-and-how-do-you-scale-it",children:["What does a successful AR pilot look like and how do you scale it",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-does-a-successful-ar-pilot-look-like-and-how-do-you-scale-it",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A well-executed AR pilot gives operations, maintenance, and HSE leaders the evidence and confidence to move from experimentation to real, scalable value. Augmented reality (AR) and AI–guided digital work instructions offer a way to:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Reduce human error by providing step-by-step, context-aware guidance"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Shorten onboarding and upskilling time for technicians and operators"}),"

"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Yet, many organisations hesitate to move beyond pilots. Concerns about hardware, integration, content creation, and change management are real. A successful AR pilot addresses these issues head-on, showing clear results and a path to scale."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"the-current-landscape-ar-pilots-proof-of-concept-fatigue-and-the-scaling-gap",children:["The current landscape: AR pilots, proof-of-concept fatigue, and the scaling gap",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-current-landscape-ar-pilots-proof-of-concept-fatigue-and-the-scaling-gap",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Most industrial teams have tested digital work instructions or AR SOPs in some form. Some see modest wins; others stall at the pilot stage. Common challenges include:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Narrow focus: Pilots often target a single process or small team, limiting their impact."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:'Lack of baseline data: Without clear "before" metrics, it's hard to prove ROI.'}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Insufficient stakeholder buy-in: Pilots run by innovation teams may not involve operations, HSE, or L&D decision makers early enough."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Content bottlenecks: Creating and maintaining AR SOPs requires new skills and workflows."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Hardware limitations: Early AR devices were bulky or unreliable in industrial settings."}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["A 2023 survey by PwC found that while 42% of industrial companies have trialed AR/VR, only 13% have scaled beyond pilots (",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.pwc.com/gx/en/issues/technology/ai-analytics/immersive-technologies.html",children:"source"}),"). The gap is not technology—it's governance, measurement, and change management."]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"defining-a-successful-ar-pilot-measurable-criteria",children:["Defining a successful AR pilot: measurable criteria",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#defining-a-successful-ar-pilot-measurable-criteria",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:'A successful AR pilot in industrial operations does more than "work" technically. It delivers:'}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Clear, quantitative improvements"})," in productivity, safety, quality, or training outcomes"]}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Stakeholder engagement"})," across operations, HSE, L&D, and IT"]}),"
",n(a.li,{children:n(a.strong,{children:"Repeatable content creation and update processes"})}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Hardware and software fit"})," for real-world environments"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Change management"})," that addresses user adoption and feedback"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Key performance indicators (KPIs) might include:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Reduction in task completion time (e.g., 20% faster equipment setup)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Fewer safety or quality incidents (e.g., 30% drop in inspection errors)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Shorter time to competence for new technicians (e.g., onboarding cut from 6 weeks to 4)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Higher SOP compliance rates (e.g., 95% vs. 80% baseline)"}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"laying-the-groundwork-how-to-plan-an-ar-pilot-for-impact",children:["Laying the groundwork: how to plan an AR pilot for impact",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#laying-the-groundwork-how-to-plan-an-ar-pilot-for-impact",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Successful AR pilots start with clear intent and strong foundations. Steps include:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Select a process with high impact and measurable pain points."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"E.g., complex maintenance tasks, safety-critical inspections, or onboarding for new equipment."}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Define baseline metrics."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Use video, time studies, QA data, or digital logs to quantify the current state."}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Identify stakeholders and champions."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Involve operations managers, HSE leaders, maintenance leads, L&D, and IT from the outset."}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Choose fit-for-purpose hardware and software."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Test devices in real environments for comfort, battery life, and connectivity."}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Map out content creation."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Decide how SOPs, checklists, and training will be digitised and maintained."}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Plan for training and change management."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Prepare short sessions and feedback loops for technicians and supervisors."}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Set a fixed pilot duration and review cadence."}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Typically 4–12 weeks, with weekly check-ins and a final review meeting."}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"

"]}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"running-the-ar-pilot-best-practices-and-pitfalls",children:["Running the AR pilot: best practices and pitfalls",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#running-the-ar-pilot-best-practices-and-pitfalls",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Collect feedback on usability, comfort, and clarity of digital work instructions."}),"
"]}),"

"]}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Treat AR SOPs as living documents—update them based on user input and observed gaps."}),"

"]}),"

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const a={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h1:"h1",h2:"h2",h3:"h3",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(a.h1,{id:"working-offline-ar-solutions-for-environments-with-limited-connectivity",children:["Working offline: AR solutions for environments with limited connectivity",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#working-offline-ar-solutions-for-environments-with-limited-connectivity",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:'Industrial operations rarely happen in perfect conditions. Whether maintaining equipment in remote plants, inspecting assets on oil platforms, or training teams deep inside mines, connectivity gaps are a fact of life. "Working offline: AR solutions for environments with limited connectivity" is now a top priority for operations, HSE, maintenance, and training leaders who need to ensure safety, quality, and productivity—regardless of network availability.'}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"connectivity-challenges-in-industrial-environments",children:["Connectivity challenges in industrial environments",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#connectivity-challenges-in-industrial-environments",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Many industrial sites operate in locations where Wi-Fi or cellular networks are unreliable or unavailable. Examples include:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Remote energy sites (oil fields, wind farms, solar plants)"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Underground mines or tunnels"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Isolated manufacturing lines in large facilities"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Shipyards, maritime vessels, or offshore rigs"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Utility substations and distributed infrastructure"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For technicians, operators, and field engineers, these connectivity gaps can create serious risks:"}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Access to digital work instructions, SOPs, and checklists becomes unreliable."}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Training and onboarding for new team members is inconsistent."}),"
"]}),"

",i(a.h2,{id:"why-working-offline-is-essential-for-safety-and-productivity",children:["Why working offline is essential for safety and productivity",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-working-offline-is-essential-for-safety-and-productivity",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.p,{children:["Industrial leaders have invested heavily in digital transformation—yet many digital tools assume always-on connectivity. This is rarely the case in the real world. According to a 2022 survey by ",n(a.a,{href:"https://www.arcweb.com/blog/why-industrial-internet-things-iiot-connectivity-matters",children:"ARC Advisory Group"}),", 40% of asset-intensive companies report frequent connectivity loss in at least part of their operations."]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"When teams cannot reliably access procedures, standards, or training materials, several problems arise:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Safety incidents increase due to missed steps or outdated information."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Planned maintenance is delayed, increasing downtime and costs."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Quality and compliance issues multiply, requiring costly rework or audits."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Onboarding and skills transfer are slowed, affecting workforce readiness."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"For decision makers, the challenge is clear: digital work instructions, AR SOPs, and AI support must function offline when and where they are needed most."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"how-ar-work-instructions-work-offline",children:["How AR work instructions work offline",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ar-work-instructions-work-offline",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Advanced AR solutions now enable teams to access AI and AR–guided work instructions even in environments with limited or no connectivity. Offline-capable AR SOPs bring several advantages:"}),"

",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Local content storage:"})," Procedures, 3D models, and checklists are stored securely on the device, not in the cloud."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Offline AI guidance:"})," Key AI-powered features—such as step-by-step guidance, image recognition, and decision support—are available without a network."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Local data capture:"})," Photos, notes, and compliance records are saved locally and synced automatically when connectivity returns."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Seamless user experience:"})," Operators and technicians use the same intuitive AR interface, regardless of network status."]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This approach ensures that critical knowledge, guidance, and compliance are always at hand—whether in a remote wind farm, a ship’s engine room, or an underground facility."}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"Automatic synchronization with central systems once online"}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Permission controls and version management to ensure the right procedures are always available"}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"These features enable teams to work smarter and safer—without waiting for a network connection."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"use-cases-ar-and-ai-work-instructions-in-limited-connectivity-environments",children:["Use cases: AR and AI work instructions in limited connectivity environments",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#use-cases-ar-and-ai-work-instructions-in-limited-connectivity-environments",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"A growing number of industrial organizations are deploying offline-capable AR solutions in the field. Below are practical examples relevant to operations, HSE, maintenance, and L&D leaders."}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"AI-powered checklists ensure every safety step is completed, even when offline."}),"

"]}),"

",i(a.h3,{id:"safety-critical-operations-in-hazardous-areas",children:["Safety-critical operations in hazardous areas",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#safety-critical-operations-in-hazardous-areas",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"

",n(a.li,{children:"AI guidance on PPE requirements and emergency protocols, even without a network."}),"

"]}),"

"]}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"During outages, disasters, or recovery operations, networks are often down. Offline AR SOPs enable:"}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",n(a.li,{children:"Access to emergency procedures, shutdown protocols, and recovery checklists on local devices."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Data collection for post-incident analysis, even if the network is disrupted."}),"
",n(a.li,{children:"Coordination of multi-site teams using pre-loaded instructions and forms."}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"This ensures continuity, safety, and traceability even in the toughest conditions."}),"
",i(a.h2,{id:"overcoming-barriers-hardware-content-and-change-management",children:["Overcoming barriers: hardware, content, and change management",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#overcoming-barriers-hardware-content-and-change-management",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"Deploying offline-capable AR solutions in industrial environments requires careful planning and execution. Key considerations include:"}),"

",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Device selection:"})," Choose rugged tablets, smart glasses, or mobile devices with sufficient storage and battery life."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Security:"})," Ensure local data is encrypted and devices are managed according to company IT policies."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Updates:"})," Plan for periodic updates to SOPs, AR models, and AI features, using scheduled syncs or portable media if needed."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(a.h3,{id:"content-creation-and-governance",children:["Content creation and governance",n(a.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#content-creation-and-governance",children:n(a.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(a.ul,{children:["
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Authoring workflows:"})," Use platforms that make it easy to create, update, and distribute digital SOPs and AR instructions."]}),"
",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Version control:"})," Ensure teams always access the latest approved procedures, even offline."]}),"

"]}),"
",i(a.blockquote,{children:["
",i(a.p,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Note:"})," Offline AR solutions do not provide live remote support or real-time collaboration. ",i(a.li,{children:[n(a.strong,{children:"Improved data quality"})," for audits, traceability, and continuous improvement"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(a.p,{children:"These benefits translate directly into higher uptime, lower operating costs, and a safer, more resilient workforce."}),"

",n(a.p,{children:"ActARion specializes in AI and AR–guided work instructions designed for the realities of industrial environments, including those with limited or no connectivity. Our platform enables:"}),"

title: Why the future of work will change
description: How technology, AI and augmented reality are reshaping work, learning and competitive advantage in technical operations.

image.alt: Why the future of work will change

author: Ortwin Verreck
body:
const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:r}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(i){const t={a:"a",blockquote:"blockquote",br:"br",h2:"h2",hr:"hr",li:"li",ol:"ol",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...i.components};return r(e,{children:[r(t.h2,{id:"the-future-of-work-started-long-before-ai",children:["The future of work started long before AI",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#the-future-of-work-started-long-before-ai",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The future of work did not start with AI."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Technology innovation has always been a continuous process that helps organisations work faster, safer and smarter."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"It started the day we put machines between people and their tasks. Ford’s assembly line transformed car building from a craft into a repeatable, standardised process. From that moment on, “technology-scaled labour” became just as important as human skill."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Over the last century, every major wave of technology did something similar: mechanisation, electrification, computers, robotics, software, and now AI. Each wave changed what “productive work” looks like, and rewarded the organisations that adopted it early."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Today we are at a new turning point. AI, combined with augmented reality (AR), is changing how we:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Capture and reuse corporate knowledge"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Train and support technical employees"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Scale expertise across sites, shifts and even countries"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Below I outline four trends that together explain why “faster, safer, smarter” is no longer a nice slogan, but the new baseline."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-1-technology-has-changed-how-we-communicate-and-solve-problems",children:["Trend 1: technology has changed how we communicate and solve problems",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-1-technology-has-changed-how-we-communicate-and-solve-problems",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Most work-related communication no longer runs via the local expert walking over to a machine."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Technicians, planners and engineers now use:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Email and messaging apps"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Teams/Zoom and remote support tools"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Ticketing systems and digital service portals"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Diagnostics that used to be done by a local mechanic are now partly performed by factory analytics systems. The factory learns from usage data, decides when to trigger a recall, and pushes standardised fixes to dealers at scale."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In many companies, more communication with colleagues, suppliers and OEMs runs through digital channels than via face-to-face conversations or phone calls. For complex problems, several experts (often outside the company) need to be involved at the same time."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This has two important effects:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Knowledge scatters"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Expertise spreads over inboxes, chat histories, meeting recordings and external partners. The better you are at capturing and structuring that knowledge, the faster, smarter and safer you can work."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Speed becomes a differentiator"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","The company that can route a question to the right expert in minutes will beat the one that needs days of internal emails and coordination."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["To keep up, organisations need systems that not only connect people, but also ",n(t.strong,{children:"capture and structure what is being said"}),", so it can be reused at scale."]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-2-technology-has-changed-how-we-learn",children:["Trend 2: technology has changed how we learn",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-2-technology-has-changed-how-we-learn",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For decades, learning at work meant classroom training, binders and thick manuals. We learned by reading text."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"We now know that learning improves when multiple senses are involved: seeing, hearing, movement and touch. That helps explain the rise of online video as a preferred learning format."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["YouTube has quietly become one of the largest learning platforms in the world. In one survey, 71% of tech employees said they use YouTube as a learning resource, and more than half of B2B buyers use video, including YouTube, to research purchases before making a decision. :contentReference[oaicite:0]",index=0," Video is also one of the fastest-growing formats for internal training and knowledge sharing. :contentReference[oaicite:1]",index=1]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In other words: traditional manuals are being replaced by searchable, visual, on-demand instructions."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"This again has two effects:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Technology enables faster learning"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","People are used to instant access to knowledge. They expect short, visual, contextual explanations instead of long documents. Training that uses more senses helps them learn faster and retain more."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Training becomes more individual"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Employees expect to access exactly the instruction they need, the moment they need it, on the device they have in their hand."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"These shifts fit modern learning behaviour, but they introduce a new risk: if you do not structure your own company knowledge, your people will fall back on “random internet advice”. That is a problem for quality, safety and compliance."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-3-technology-adoption-is-accelerating",children:["Trend 3: technology adoption is accelerating",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-3-technology-adoption-is-accelerating",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"A third trend is the speed at which new technology spreads."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Historically, it took decades for technologies like the telephone, electricity or television to reach tens of millions of users. Today, this happens in months, sometimes weeks."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["ChatGPT is a clear example. It is estimated to have reached around 100 million users within about two months of launch, making it one of the fastest-growing consumer applications in history. :contentReference[oaicite:2]",index=2]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Why do new tools spread so quickly?"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Digital infrastructure (devices, networks, cloud) is already in place"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"People are used to learning new apps and interfaces"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Business models are designed for rapid global scaling"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Network effects reward early adopters"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For companies, this creates a new operational question:"}),"
",r(t.blockquote,{children:["
",n(t.p,{children:"Are we able to adopt new technology fast enough to keep our competitive position?"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If your organisation needs years to standardise a new way of working, while competitors roll out AI- or AR-based training and procedures in months, you risk falling behind on productivity, safety and quality."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"trend-4-a-new-labour-market-reality",children:["Trend 4: a new labour market reality",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#trend-4-a-new-labour-market-reality",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The workforce itself is changing."}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["Many experienced technicians and operators are retiring, taking decades of tacit knowledge with them. At the same time, manufacturers and technical sectors across Europe report persistent difficulties in finding qualified staff, especially for technical and engineering roles. :contentReference[oaicite:3]",index=3]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Younger generations entering the labour market bring different expectations:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"They value flexibility, learning opportunities and work-life balance"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"They are more willing to change jobs if they feel unsupported or stuck"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"They are comfortable learning from video and interactive content, and expect modern digital tools"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Demand for skilled technicians is growing (more automation, more regulation, energy transition), while supply is constrained and more mobile than before."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The result:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Tenure in technical roles decreases"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Vacancies stay open longer"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Corporate knowledge leaks away as people move on"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"“Hiring more people” or “organising more classroom training” is not enough anymore."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"why-faster-safer-smarter-is-the-new-baseline",children:["Why faster, safer, smarter is the new baseline",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-faster-safer-smarter-is-the-new-baseline",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If we combine these trends, a clear picture emerges:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Work is more complex and regulated"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Technology cycles are shorter"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Fewer experienced people stay long enough to pass on their knowledge"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Learning is just-in-time, mobile and video-first"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"In this context, competitive advantage will belong to companies that:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Capture knowledge systematically"})," instead of letting it live in people’s heads, inboxes and chat histories"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Deliver knowledge in context"}),", at the moment of need, in a format that fits the task"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use technology to make average employees perform like experts"})," on complex work"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"That is what “faster, safer, smarter” means in practice:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Faster"}),": employees find and apply the right knowledge immediately"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Safer"}),": instructions are standardised, up-to-date and auditable"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Smarter"}),": the system learns from every task, error and improvement"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"why-organisations-embrace-ar-and-ai-to-get-there",children:["Why organisations embrace AR and AI to get there",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#why-organisations-embrace-ar-and-ai-to-get-there",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"All four trends point in the same direction:"}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["We need better ways to ",n(t.strong,{children:"capture, structure and deliver corporate knowledge"})," if we want people to work faster, safer and smarter."]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["This is where the combination of ",n(t.strong,{children:"AI and augmented reality"})," becomes relevant."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"We already see organisations using AR and AI together to:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Turn expert know-how into structured procedures"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Guide people through complex tasks in the real environment"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Support technicians remotely, without flying experts around"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Measure training speed, quality and error patterns across sites"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Adopting new technology has created competitive advantage for decades. Today, adopting AI-driven SOPs and AR-based guidance is simply the next step in that same story."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"turning-new-technology-into-standard-work",children:["Turning new technology into standard work",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#turning-new-technology-into-standard-work",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The key question is not “Should we use AI and AR?” but:"}),"
",r(t.blockquote,{children:["
",n(t.p,{children:"Are we able to turn new technology into standard work, at scale?"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Practically, that means building a repeatable loop:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use AI to draft SOPs and training flows"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Start from existing manuals, videos or expert interviews. Let AI propose the first version of a work instruction or training path."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use AR to guide people through tasks in the field"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Instead of only sending a video or PDF, overlay clear, step-by-step instructions in the real environment. This makes execution more intuitive and reduces interpretation errors."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Use analytics to refine and standardise"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Measure how long steps take, where people get stuck, which errors occur and which variants are used. Update the instructions based on real-world usage."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Measure learning speed and performance"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Track how quickly employees reach competence and where additional support is needed. Use these insights to improve both training and process design."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Companies that build this “adaptation muscle” can roll out new processes in months instead of years, and capture more value from AI, automation and new equipment."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"reducing-pressure-on-scarce-experts",children:["Reducing pressure on scarce experts",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#reducing-pressure-on-scarce-experts",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["The shortage of senior experts will not disappear. But we can ",n(t.strong,{children:"change how we use their time"}),"."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI and AR can help by:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Handling routine guidance so experts can focus on truly complex cases"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Allowing mid-level technicians, supported by AR instructions, to safely execute tasks that previously required a specialist"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Embedding remote expert support into AR, so you can “borrow” expertise across sites instead of staffing every location with every skill set"}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["In other words: ",n(t.strong,{children:"AI and AR do not replace experts, they amplify them"}),"."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"You move from “we depend on John who knows this machine” to “we depend on a living knowledge system that John helped create”."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"building-company-knowledge-on-a-global-scale",children:["Building company knowledge on a global scale",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#building-company-knowledge-on-a-global-scale",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Once procedures are captured in a structured digital format, they become:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Searchable"}),": people can find the right step or variant instantly"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Translatable"}),": instructions can be reused across languages and regions"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Measurable"}),": you can see who used which procedure, when, and with what result"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Reusable"}),": the same knowledge can support plants, service teams and partners"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"For global organisations, this is crucial. You can roll out the same standard to multiple sites, adapt for local regulations, and still compare performance."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The knowledge of your best expert becomes available in all languages, 24/7, instead of being tied to one person in one location."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"how-ai-improves-learning-speed-and-reduces-errors",children:["How AI improves learning speed and reduces errors",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#how-ai-improves-learning-speed-and-reduces-errors",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AI capabilities that are already practical today include:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Suggesting the next best instruction step based on similar jobs and histories"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Translating SOPs into other languages"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Turning raw expert video into structured work instructions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Flagging where errors occur most often, so you can redesign the process or add extra checks"}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.p,{children:["Combined with AR, this means a new technician can ",n(t.strong,{children:"learn while doing"}),", guided step by step in the real environment, instead of spending days in a classroom and then trying to remember the manual."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The impact is tangible:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Faster onboarding"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Better retention of knowledge"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Fewer mistakes in the field"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Which is exactly where “faster, safer, smarter” becomes visible in day-to-day work."}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"what-competitive-advantage-looks-like-in-practice",children:["What competitive advantage looks like in practice",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#what-competitive-advantage-looks-like-in-practice",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Organisations that get this right typically see advantages in five areas:"}),"
",r(t.ol,{children:["
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Productivity"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","More work done with the same or fewer people, because less time is wasted searching for information or waiting for an expert."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Quality and safety"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Standardised digital instructions reduce variation, error rates and incidents, and make audits more straightforward."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Scalability"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","New lines, plants or services can be launched without needing a full team of senior experts at each location. Knowledge scales faster than headcount."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Talent attraction and retention"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","Younger employees prefer employers who offer modern tools and clear learning paths. A strong digital knowledge environment is a real asset in the labour market."]}),"
"]}),"
",r(t.li,{children:["
",r(t.p,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Resilience"}),n(t.br,{}),"
","When key people retire or leave, their knowledge is not lost. It lives in your system and can be improved by the next generation."]}),"
"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",r(t.h2,{id:"where-actarion-fits-in",children:["Where ActARion fits in",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#where-actarion-fits-in",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"At ActARion, we see these trends every day in manufacturing, logistics and energy."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Together with our partner DeepSight, we help organisations:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Capture expert knowledge once and reuse it across sites"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Turn that knowledge into AI-supported SOPs and AR instructions"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Support technicians in the field with guided workflows and remote experts"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Measure how training and execution actually perform in practice"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"Not every company is ready to redesign all their processes at once. Often, the best next step is simple:"}),"
",r(t.ul,{children:["
",n(t.li,{children:"Pick one high-impact use case"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Capture the current best way of working"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Turn it into an AR-guided, AI-supported instruction"}),"
",n(t.li,{children:"Measure the effect on speed, safety and errors"}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"From there, you can decide how fast you want to scale."}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"If you recognise the trends described in this article and want to explore what “faster, safer, smarter” could look like in your own operations, a short discovery workshop or proof of concept is usually the most concrete way to start."})]})}return{default:function(e={}){const{wrapper:r}=e.components||{};return r?n(r,{...e,children:n(_createMdxContent,{...e})}):_createMdxContent(e)}};

const{Fragment:e,jsx:n,jsxs:i}=arguments[0];function _createMdxContent(r){const t={a:"a",h2:"h2",hr:"hr",li:"li",p:"p",span:"span",strong:"strong",ul:"ul",...r.components};return i(e,{children:[i(t.p,{children:["For decades, industries such as manufacturing, logistics, and field service have struggled with the ",n(t.strong,{children:"high cost of change"}),". Implementing new processes, training diverse workforces, and ensuring consistent quality across regions requires significant investments of time and resources. Today, that is changing as organizations embrace ",n(t.strong,{children:"augmented reality (AR)–enabled Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)"})," to modernize their operations."]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"AR SOP solutions empower companies to address some of their most pressing challenges:"}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Workforce transitions"})," as experienced staff retire and new talent must be onboarded faster"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Growing process complexity"})," as machines, regulations, and global supply chains evolve"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Efficiency demands"})," requiring higher first-time fix rates and reduced downtime"]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"The need for compliance and safety"}),", with fewer resources available for oversight"]}),"
"]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"competitors-have-paved-the-way",children:["Competitors Have Paved the Way",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#competitors-have-paved-the-way",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",n(t.p,{children:"The rise of AR solutions in industry has been validated by several leading players."}),"
",i(t.ul,{children:["
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"PTC Vuforia"})," – Enterprise AR portfolio for visualization and remote assistance, helping frontline workers execute complex tasks with fewer errors."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Microsoft Dynamics 365 Guides"})," – Delivers holographic, step-by-step instructions on HoloLens and other devices, accelerating onboarding and training."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Poka"})," – A connected worker platform offering digital libraries, training tracking, and shift-to-shift collaboration."]}),"
",i(t.li,{children:[n(t.strong,{children:"Visual Knowledge Share (VKS)"})," – Focused on digitized work instructions and operator upskilling, supporting standardized training and certification."]}),"
"]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["Together, these solutions have proven that ",n(t.strong,{children:"digitizing knowledge and instructions creates measurable value"}),", helping companies reduce errors, speed up training, and capture expertise from the field."]}),"
",n(t.hr,{}),"
",i(t.h2,{id:"where-actarion-goes-further",children:["Where ActARion Goes Further",n(t.a,{"aria-hidden":"true",tabIndex:"-1",href:"#where-actarion-goes-further",children:n(t.span,{className:"icon icon-link"})})]}),"
",i(t.p,{children:["While these competitors have validated the market need, many still take a ",n(t.strong,{children:"fragmented approach"}),". Some excel in ",n(t.strong,{children:"authoring"})," but lack ",n(t.strong,{children:"real-time validation"}),". Others connect workers but offer limited ",n(t.strong,{children:"smart glasses integration"}),". Most lack the ",n(t.strong,{children:"AI-driven quality checks"})," that ensure compliance at every step of a process."]}),"

description: On 14 November, ActARion hosted an event about smarter, safer and faster work with AI and Augmented Reality. This is what we learned.

author: ActARion Team
